## Supplementary Material

**Supplementary Table 1: Exclusion criteria for controls.** In the UK Biobank, ICD-9 and ICD-10 diagnostic codes were checked for in the Cancer Register (fields 40006 and 40013), Hospital Episode Statistics (fields 41270 and 41271), and Death Register (fields 40001 and 40002); OPCS-4 codes were checked for in the Operative procedures (field 41272). Other than M61 (Prostatectomy), OPCS-4 codes were not used as control exclusion criteria in the Our Future Health cohort.

```{r supplementary_table1, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, cache=FALSE}

if (!requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("flextable")
}
if (!requireNamespace("officer", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("officer")
}

library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# ICD section
icd_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~description,                                                  ~code_icd9, ~code_icd10,
  "Personal history of malignant neoplasm of genital organs",   "V10.4",    "Z85.4",
  "Carcinoma in situ of prostate",                               "233.4",    "D07.5",
  "Neoplasm of uncertain behaviour of prostate",                 "236.5",    "D40.0",
  "Dysplasia of prostate",                                       "602.3",    "N42.3"
)

# OPCS-4 section
opcs_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~description,                                               ~code,
  "Prostatectomy",                                            "M61",
  "Radiotherapy Delivery",                                    "X65",
  "Preparation of radiotherapy",                              "X67",
  "Brachytherapy preparation",                                "X68",
  "Radioactive seed implantation into prostate",              "M70.6",
  "Introduction Material Radioactive Removable NOC",          "Y35",
  "Introduction Material Non-removable NOC",                  "Y36",
  "Block dissection of pelvic lymph nodes",                   "T85.6",
  "Orchidectomy",                                             "N04",
  "Endoscopic resection of prostate",                         "M65",
  "Endoscopic insertion of prosthesis into prostate",         "M68",
  "Endoscopic cryotherapy to lesion of prostate",             "M67.1",
  "High intensity focused ultrasound of prostate",            "M71.1",
  "Implantation of radioactive substance into prostate",      "M71.2"
)

# Combine the two sections.
# The fifth row is an internal section heading.
table_data <- bind_rows(
  icd_data,
  tibble(
    description = "Description",
    code_icd9   = "Code (OPCS-4)",
    code_icd10  = ""
  ),
  opcs_data |>
    transmute(
      description,
      code_icd9  = code,
      code_icd10 = ""
    )
)

# Record the row positions used for formatting
opcs_header_row <- nrow(icd_data) + 1
opcs_body_rows  <- (opcs_header_row + 1):nrow(table_data)

# Preserve a plain data frame version for Excel export, since flextable objects cannot be coerced to data.frame
supplementary_table1_df <- table_data |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Description` = description,
    `Code (ICD-9)` = code_icd9,
    `Code (ICD-10)` = code_icd10
  )

# Construct the table
supplementary_table1 <- flextable(table_data) |>
  
  set_header_labels(
    description = "Description",
    code_icd9   = "Code (ICD-9)",
    code_icd10  = "Code (ICD-10)"
  ) |>
  
  # Merge the two code cells in the internal OPCS-4 heading row
  merge_at(
    i = opcs_header_row,
    j = c("code_icd9", "code_icd10"),
    part = "body"
  )

# Merge columns 2 and 3 separately within each OPCS-4 row
for (row_number in opcs_body_rows) {
  supplementary_table1 <- merge_at(
    supplementary_table1,
    i = row_number,
    j = c("code_icd9", "code_icd10"),
    part = "body"
  )
}

# Continue formatting the table
supplementary_table1 <- supplementary_table1 |>
  theme_box() |>
  
  # Header formatting
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(
    j = "description",
    align = "left",
    part = "header"
  ) |>
  align(
    j = c("code_icd9", "code_icd10"),
    align = "center",
    part = "header"
  ) |>
  
  # Internal OPCS-4 header formatting
  bold(i = opcs_header_row, part = "body") |>
  align(
    i = opcs_header_row,
    j = "description",
    align = "left",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  align(
    i = opcs_header_row,
    j = c("code_icd9", "code_icd10"),
    align = "center",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  
  # Body alignment
  align(
    j = "description",
    align = "left",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  align(
    j = c("code_icd9", "code_icd10"),
    align = "center",
    part = "body"
  ) |>
  
  # Vertical alignment and padding
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all") |>
  padding(
    padding.top = 4,
    padding.bottom = 4,
    padding.left = 4,
    padding.right = 4,
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  
  # Font formatting
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") |>
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
  
  # Column widths
  width(j = "description", width = 4.8) |>
  width(j = "code_icd9", width = 1.15) |>
  width(j = "code_icd10", width = 1.15) |>
  
  set_table_properties(
    layout = "fixed",
    width = 1
  )

supplementary_table1

```

**Supplementary Table 8:** Algorithmic Fairness Metrics by decision threshold for White and Black men.

```{r supplementary_table8, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, cache=FALSE}


##      This will be a layered table containing a main header: Population, Screening Date, Predictor, (Outcome will be PrCa_10yrs but not displayed)
##              then subtitles: Lowest Useful Threshold, Youden's J Threshold, Highest Useful Threshold
##                    then for each of these thresholds, (C1, C2, C3, respectively), present sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, TE, Accuracy

### Specify models to include in this table

supplementary_table8_models <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Population, ~Screening_Date, ~Predictor, ~Covariates,
  #"Black",     "date40",        "GRS451-AFR",   "None",      # date40 removed due to suppressed counts
  #"White",     "date40",        "GRS269-Multi", "None",
  "Black",     "date50",        "GRS451-AFR",   "None",
  "White",     "date50",        "GRS269-Multi", "None",
  "Black",     "date60",        "GRS451-AFR",   "None",
  "White",     "date60",        "GRS269-Multi", "None",
  "Black",     "artificial_screening_date",        "GRS451-AFR",   "age_asd",
  "White",     "artificial_screening_date",        "GRS269-Multi", "age_asd"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Model_order = dplyr::row_number()) # to maintain model order

## Fetch and prepare data

supplementary_table8_algorithmic_fairness_data <-
  asymptomatic_screening_OFH %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Outcome == "PrCa_10yrs"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    supplementary_table8_models,
    by = c(
      "Population",
      "Screening_Date",
      "Predictor",
      "Covariates"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Model_order,
    Population,
    Screening_Date,
    Predictor,
    Covariates,

    C1_cutoff,
    C1_sensitivity,
    C1_specificity,
    C1_PPV,
    C1_NPV,
    C1_Treatment_Equality,
    C1_Accuracy,

    C2_cutoff,
    C2_sensitivity,
    C2_specificity,
    C2_PPV,
    C2_NPV,
    C2_Treatment_Equality,
    C2_Accuracy,

    C3_cutoff,
    C3_sensitivity,
    C3_specificity,
    C3_PPV,
    C3_NPV,
    C3_Treatment_Equality,
    C3_Accuracy,

    Custom_0p01_cutoff,
    Custom_0p01_sensitivity,
    Custom_0p01_specificity,
    Custom_0p01_PPV,
    Custom_0p01_NPV,
    Custom_0p01_Treatment_Equality,
    Custom_0p01_Accuracy,

    Custom_0p02_cutoff,
    Custom_0p02_sensitivity,
    Custom_0p02_specificity,
    Custom_0p02_PPV,
    Custom_0p02_NPV,
    Custom_0p02_Treatment_Equality,
    Custom_0p02_Accuracy,

    Custom_0p03_cutoff,
    Custom_0p03_sensitivity,
    Custom_0p03_specificity,
    Custom_0p03_PPV,
    Custom_0p03_NPV,
    Custom_0p03_Treatment_Equality,
    Custom_0p03_Accuracy,

    Custom_0p04_cutoff,
    Custom_0p04_sensitivity,
    Custom_0p04_specificity,
    Custom_0p04_PPV,
    Custom_0p04_NPV,
    Custom_0p04_Treatment_Equality,
    Custom_0p04_Accuracy,

    Custom_0p05_cutoff,
    Custom_0p05_sensitivity,
    Custom_0p05_specificity,
    Custom_0p05_PPV,
    Custom_0p05_NPV,
    Custom_0p05_Treatment_Equality,
    Custom_0p05_Accuracy,

    Custom_0p1_cutoff,
    Custom_0p1_sensitivity,
    Custom_0p1_specificity,
    Custom_0p1_PPV,
    Custom_0p1_NPV,
    Custom_0p1_Treatment_Equality,
    Custom_0p1_Accuracy
  )

## Sanity check: did each requested model match exactly one row?

supplementary_table8_model_check <-
  supplementary_table8_algorithmic_fairness_data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Model_order,
    Population,
    Screening_Date,
    Predictor,
    Covariates,
    name = "n"
  ) 

stopifnot(
  nrow(supplementary_table8_model_check) == nrow(supplementary_table8_models),
  all(supplementary_table8_model_check$n == 1)
)

## Reshape from one row per model to three rows per model

supplementary_table8_algorithmic_fairness_long <-
  supplementary_table8_algorithmic_fairness_data %>%

  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::matches("^(C[123]|Custom_0p0[1-5])_|Custom_0p[1-5]_"),
    names_to = c("Threshold_code", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(C[123]|Custom_0p0[1-5]|Custom_0p[1-5])_(.+)$"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    ## Give each threshold a descriptive row label; custom cutoffs are left blank
    Threshold = dplyr::case_when(
      Threshold_code == "C1" ~ "Lowest Useful Threshold",
      Threshold_code == "C2" ~ "Youden's J Threshold",
      Threshold_code == "C3" ~ "Highest Useful Threshold",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    ## Fix the order of the threshold rows
    Threshold_order = match(
      Threshold_code,
      c("Custom_0p01", "Custom_0p02", "Custom_0p03", "Custom_0p04", "Custom_0p05", "Custom_0p1", "C1", "C2", "C3")
    ),

    ## Recode screening dates for display in the model headings
    Screening_Date_display = dplyr::recode(
      Screening_Date,
      #"date40" = "age 40",         # date40 removed due to suppressed counts
      "date50" = "age 50",
      "date60" = "age 60",
      "artificial_screening_date" = "31/12/2013",
      .default = Screening_Date
    ),

    ## Recode covariates for display
    Covariates_display = dplyr::recode(
      Covariates,
      "None" = "None",
      "age_asd" = "Age on 31/12/2013",
      .default = Covariates
    ),

    ## Construct the heading used by pack_rows()
    Model_heading = dplyr::if_else(
      Covariates == "None",
      paste0(
        Population,
        " men, screening at ",
        Screening_Date_display,
        ", ",
        Predictor
      ),
      paste0(
        Population,
        " men, screening at ",
        Screening_Date_display,
        ", ",
        Predictor,
        " + ",
        Covariates_display
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  ## Arrange the completed dataframe, not the Model_heading vector
  dplyr::arrange(
    Model_order,
    Threshold_order
  )

## Format displayed values

supplementary_table8_algorithmic_fairness_formatted <- supplementary_table8_algorithmic_fairness_long %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Model_order,
    Model_heading,
    Threshold_order,

    `Decision Threshold` = Threshold,

    Cutoff = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(cutoff),
      "Not found",
      paste0(
        formatC(
          100 * cutoff,
          format = "f",
          digits = 1
        ),
        "%"
      )
    ),

    Sensitivity = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(sensitivity),
      "Suppressed",
      formatC(
        sensitivity,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    ),

    Specificity = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(specificity),
      "Suppressed",
      formatC(
        specificity,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    ),

    PPV = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(PPV),
      "Suppressed",
      formatC(
        PPV,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    ),

    NPV = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(NPV),
      "Suppressed",
      formatC(
        NPV,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    ),

    TE = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(Treatment_Equality),
      "Suppressed",
      formatC(
        Treatment_Equality,
        format = "f",
        digits = 2
      )
    ),

    Accuracy = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(Accuracy),
      "Suppressed",
      formatC(
        Accuracy,
        format = "f",
        digits = 3
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r supplementary_tables_xlsx, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, cache=FALSE}
## Combine all supplementary tables into a single Excel file, with an index page then each table in sequence with the key S1-S7

if(!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("openxlsx")
}

index_page <- data.frame(
  Table = c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8"),
  Description = c(
    "Supplementary Table 1: Exclusion criteria for controls.** In the UK Biobank, ICD-9 and ICD-10 diagnostic codes were checked for in the Cancer Register (fields 40006 and 40013), Hospital Episode Statistics (fields 41270 and 41271), and Death Register (fields 40001 and 40002); OPCS-4 codes were checked for in the Operative procedures (field 41272). Other than M61 (Prostatectomy), OPCS-4 codes were not used as control exclusion criteria in the Our Future Health cohort.",
    "Supplementary Table 2: PrCa case/control counts for self-reported ethnicity and genetic similarity groups. PPV = Positive Predictive Value; NPV = Negative Predictive Value; TE = Treatment Equality. Algorithmic fairness metrics are suppressed where True Positive (TP), True Negative (TN), False Positive (FP) or False Negative (FN) counts were below 10 to prevent back-calculation. Scenarios in which participants' 40th birthdays are used as the index date resulted in suppression of all algorithmic fairness metrics due to small case counts, so these rows were removed for readability. Thresholds 0.01 through 0.50 were assessed in increments of 0.01.",
    "Supplementary Table 3: ROC AUC and OR per SD for UK Biobank Logistic Regression models",
    "Supplementary Table 4: ROC AUC and OR per SD for Our Future Health Logistic Regression models",
    "Supplementary Table 5: Unpaired DeLong test results for UK Biobank models",
    "Supplementary Table 6: Paired DeLong test results for UK Biobank models",
    "Supplementary Table 7: Unpaired DeLong test results for Our Future Health models",
    "Supplementary Table 8: Algorithmic Fairness Metrics by decision threshold for White and Black men"
  )
)

## Helper to write a sheet where certain row ranges are preceded by a
## bold, full-width group label row (replicates kableExtra::pack_rows)
write_grouped_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, df, group_bounds, header_style, group_style) {

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

  n_cols <- ncol(df)

  # Header row
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet_name, df[0, , drop = FALSE], startRow = 1, headerStyle = header_style)
  current_row <- 2

  for (group_name in names(group_bounds)) {

    bounds <- group_bounds[[group_name]]
    group_data <- df[bounds[1]:bounds[2], , drop = FALSE]

    # Group label row, merged across all columns
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet_name, x = group_name, startRow = current_row, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
    openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:n_cols, rows = current_row)
    openxlsx::addStyle(wb, sheet_name, style = group_style, rows = current_row, cols = 1:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
    current_row <- current_row + 1

    # Group data rows
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet_name, x = group_data, startRow = current_row, colNames = FALSE)
    current_row <- current_row + nrow(group_data)
  }

  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:n_cols, widths = "auto")
}

wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = "#D9D9D9", border = "TopBottom")
group_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = "#F2F2F2")
internal_header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")

## Index sheet

openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Index")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Index", index_page, headerStyle = header_style)
openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "Index", cols = 1:2, widths = c(8, 120))

## S1: preserve the internal "OPCS-4" heading row (bold, merged code columns)

openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "S1")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "S1", supplementary_table1_df, headerStyle = header_style)
s1_internal_header_excel_row <- opcs_header_row + 1  # +1 to account for the column header row
openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "S1", cols = 2:3, rows = s1_internal_header_excel_row)
openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "S1", style = internal_header_style, rows = s1_internal_header_excel_row, cols = 1:3, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "S1", cols = 1:3, widths = c(70, 20, 20))

## S2: preserve the cohort/screening-date group headings

s2_group_bounds <- list(
  "UK Biobank" = c(1, ukb_end_row),
  "Our Future Health, screening at 31/12/2013" = c(ukb_end_row + 1, ofh_date40_end_row),
  "Our Future Health, screening at age 40" = c(ofh_date40_end_row + 1, ofh_date50_end_row),
  "Our Future Health, screening at age 50" = c(ofh_date50_end_row + 1, ofh_date60_end_row),
  "Our Future Health, screening at age 60" = c(ofh_date60_end_row + 1, ofh_date60_end_row)
)

write_grouped_sheet(wb, "S2", supplementary_table2, s2_group_bounds, header_style, group_style)

## S8: preserve the model/threshold group headings, derived from its existing group-size index

s8_group_ends <- cumsum(supplementary_table8_group_index)
s8_group_starts <- s8_group_ends - supplementary_table8_group_index + 1L
s8_group_bounds <- Map(c, s8_group_starts, s8_group_ends)
names(s8_group_bounds) <- names(supplementary_table8_group_index)

write_grouped_sheet(wb, "S8", supplementary_table8_display, s8_group_bounds, header_style, group_style)

## S3-S7: plain sheets

for (sheet_name in c("S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7")) {
  sheet_data <- get(paste0("supplementary_table", substr(sheet_name, 2, 2)))
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet_name, sheet_data, headerStyle = header_style)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(sheet_data), widths = "auto")
}

openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file = "supplementary_tables.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r supplementary_figure1, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, cache=FALSE, fig.height=9}
if(!requireNamespace("cowplot", quietly = TRUE)) {

## Helper function to crop OR per SD plots' left margin

remove_left_axis_space <- function(plot, left_margin_pt = 4) {
  # Convert the ggplot into its underlying gtable
  plot_grob <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(plot)
  # Identify grobs associated with the left axis and y-axis title
  left_axis_rows <- grepl(
    pattern = "^(axis-l|ylab-l)",
    x = plot_grob$layout$name
  )
  # Identify the gtable columns occupied by those grobs
  left_axis_columns <- unique(
    plot_grob$layout$l[left_axis_rows]
  )
  # Set those columns to zero width
  if (length(left_axis_columns) > 0) {
    plot_grob$widths[left_axis_columns] <- grid::unit(
      rep(left_margin_pt, length(left_axis_columns)),
      "pt"
    )
  }

  plot_grob
}
```

```{r supplementary_figure2, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, cache=FALSE, fig.height=9}
  OR_per_SD_forestplot_10yr +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  left_margin_pt = 4
)

## Collate as a multi-panel figure, with only one legend for the whole figure

library(cowplot)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  ROC_AUC_forestplot_2yr +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.box = "vertical",

      # Keep some separation on the left, but no padding on the right
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 5),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),

      legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.8, "cm")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        ncol = 1,
        override.aes = list(size = 3)
      )
    )
)

legend_right <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_grob(
    legend,
    x = 1,
    y = 0.5,
    width = 1,
    height = 1,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 0.5
  )

roc_auc_panels <- plot_grid(
  ROC_AUC_forestplot_2yr +
    labs(y = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  ROC_AUC_forestplot_5yr_cropped,
  ROC_AUC_forestplot_10yr_cropped,
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(1.15, 0.85, 0.85),
  label_size = 14,
  label_fontface = "bold",
  label_x = 0,
  label_y = 1,
  hjust = 0,
  vjust = 1
)

roc_auc_row <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_plot(
    roc_auc_panels,
    x = 0,
    y = 0.10,
    width = 1,
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  cowplot::draw_label("A", x = 0.1, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 14, fontface = "bold") +
  cowplot::draw_label("B", x = 0.4, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 14, fontface = "bold") +
  cowplot::draw_label("C", x = 0.7, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 14, fontface = "bold") +
  cowplot::draw_label("2-year", x = 1.6 / 6, y = 0.1, size = 10) +
  cowplot::draw_label("5-year", x = 3.4 / 6, y = 0.1, size = 10) +
  cowplot::draw_label("10-year", x = 5.2 / 6, y = 0.1, size = 10) +
  cowplot::draw_label("ROC AUC [95% CI]", x = 0.57, y = 0.05, size = 11, fontface = "bold")

or_per_sd_panel_widths <- c(1.15, 0.85, 0.85)
or_per_sd_panel_widths <- or_per_sd_panel_widths / sum(or_per_sd_panel_widths)

or_per_sd_row <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_plot(
    OR_per_SD_forestplot_2yr +
      labs(y = NULL) +
      theme(legend.position = "none"),
    x = 0,
    y = 0.10,
    width = or_per_sd_panel_widths[[1]],
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(
    OR_per_SD_forestplot_5yr_cropped,
    x = or_per_sd_panel_widths[[1]],
    y = 0.10,
    width = or_per_sd_panel_widths[[2]],
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(
    OR_per_SD_forestplot_10yr_cropped,
    x = sum(or_per_sd_panel_widths[1:2]),
    y = 0.10,
    width = or_per_sd_panel_widths[[3]],
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  cowplot::draw_label("D", x = 0.1, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 14, fontface = "bold") +
  cowplot::draw_label("E", x = 0.4, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 14, fontface = "bold") +
  cowplot::draw_label("F", x = 0.7, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 14, fontface = "bold") +
  cowplot::draw_label("2-year", x = 1.6 / 6, y = 0.1, size = 10) +
  cowplot::draw_label("5-year", x = 3.4 / 6, y = 0.1, size = 10) +
  cowplot::draw_label("10-year", x = 5.2 / 6, y = 0.1, size = 10) +
  cowplot::draw_label("OR per 1SD [95% CI]", x = 0.57, y = 0.05, size = 11, fontface = "bold")

plots <- plot_grid(
  roc_auc_row,
  or_per_sd_row,
  ncol = 1,
  nrow = 2,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1)
)

multi_panel_figure_supplementary2 <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_plot(
    plots,
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    width = 0.74,
    height = 1
  ) +
  cowplot::draw_plot(
    legend_right,
    x = 0.74,
    y = 0,
    width = 0.26,
    height = 1
  )

## ggsave the figure then import

figure_path_supplementary2 <- file.path("figures", "multi_panel_figure_supplementary2.png")

dir.create(
  dirname(figure_path_supplementary2),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = figure_path_supplementary2,
  plot = multi_panel_figure_supplementary2,
  width = 170,
  height = 170,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

knitr::include_graphics(figure_path_supplementary2)
```
